name: Cam-operated limit switch
summary: A cam-operated limit switch changes its electrical contact state when a defined cam profile reaches the actuator.
description: A cam-operated limit switch changes its electrical contact state when a defined cam profile reaches the actuator. Its position function depends on the documented cam and mechanism relationship.
readingNotes: Link the cam position to the electrical contact schedule.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Cam actuation is a mechanical input, not an electrically programmed timer.
